title: 第4章 压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草
slug: 学霸女神超给力全本免费-学霸女神超给力最新章节列表
content_zh:
当时的云画只能死死地抱着自己，压根儿睁不开眼。
她努力地退缩再退缩，一直缩到草丛里。
可那么多双眼睛，那么多簇目光，跟探照灯一样，扒开她的所有伪装，让她的一切都暴露在众目睽睽之下。
礼义廉耻，羞涩自尊，统统被人狠狠地踩在脚下践踏。
那一刻，云画真是连死的心都有。
“你们两个叫什么名字，哪个班的，真是不知羞耻。”
韩军栋的声音如刀，“孤男寡女，三更半夜在这种地方，你们才几岁？你们爹妈就是这么教你们的？学校禁制早恋，强调了几百次你们都没听进去是吧。我就没见过你们这么厚脸皮的！还有你，那个女生，瞅瞅你什么样子，懂不懂什么叫自尊自爱，就那么轻贱你自己？”
“相当小姐呗。”有人在边上嘲讽。
当时云画全身的血都冷了，牙齿都在打颤。
“还有这个男生，谈恋爱都谈到这种地方来了，三更半夜能跟你来这地方见面的女生会是什么好东西？你自己也一点都不知道要脸。”韩军栋嘴巴毒的要死。
贺御翔的脸色变了变，立刻说道，“韩主任，你可冤枉我了，是她约我来的，不信你看，短信还在这儿呢。她以前就对我死缠烂打的，我压根儿没理她好不好。这次来是因为她说……”
“她说什么你都来？”韩军栋冷笑。
贺御翔双手插在裤兜里：“她说我不来的话，她就要自杀，你说我能不来吗？再说了，韩主任，我什么身份她什么身份，一个乡下来的土妞，我能看上她？”
韩军栋狐疑地大量了贺御翔一番，“她要自杀你不会来告诉老师？非得自己来？反正今天这事儿你们两个谁都跑不掉！”
被抓现行。
叫家长，在全校大会上被拉上台，全校当众批评。
当时被叫来学校的云从军觉得丢人，狠狠地给了云画几个大耳刮子，骂云画不知羞耻长大也是当小姐的料，而后更是当着全校师生的面，拽着她的头发把她一路拖出学校……
云画彻底出名了。
在南溪中学无人不知无人不晓，无论她走到哪儿都有人指指点点。
学生中更是传出流言，说她小小年纪就自甘下贱，就会勾.引男人，说她早就不干净等等。

这其中还有韩军栋的女儿韩露露的功劳。
原因很简单，韩露露在追求贺御翔，发生了这件事情之后，韩露露坚持认为是云画勾.引贺御翔，导致贺御翔被抓且也不得不当众作检讨，在全校师生面前丢尽脸。
总之一切都是云画的错！
韩露露同学十分大方地又帮云画编制了不少流言，传得跟真的一样！
这些已经足以压垮幼小的云画，可是最让她痛苦的，还是齐子衡。
发生了这些事情，云画百口莫辩。
齐子衡看她的眼神，更是充满了失望……
齐家甚至派人来通知，说要解除当年的婚约！
简直晴天霹雳。

content_en:
At that time, Yun Hua could only hug himself tightly, unable to open his eyes at all.
She tried her best to shrink back again and again, until she shrank into the grass.
But so many pairs of eyes, so many clusters of gazes, like searchlights, peeled off all her disguises and exposed everything about her to the public eye.
Etiquette, integrity, shame, shyness and self-esteem are all trampled under people's feet.
At that moment, Yun Hua really wanted to die.
"What are your names and which classes are you two in? You are so shameless."
Han Jundong's voice was like a knife, "How old are you, a man and a woman alone, in a place like this in the middle of the night? Is this what your parents taught you? The school prohibits puppy love. I have stressed it hundreds of times and you haven't listened, right? I've never seen you so shameless! And you, that girl, look at you, do you know what self-respect and self-love are, and you are so contemptuous of yourself?"
"Quite young lady." Someone mocked from the side.
At that time, the blood all over Yun Hua's body was cold and his teeth were chattering.
"And this boy, we talk about this kind of place when we are in love. What kind of girl can you come to meet here in the middle of the night? You don't even know how to be shameless." Han Jundong's mouth was extremely venomous.
He Yuxiang's expression changed and he immediately said, "Director Han, you have wronged me. It was she who invited me here. If you don't believe me, look, the text message is still here. She has been stalking me before, and I didn't pay attention to her at all. I came this time because she said..."
"You'll come even if she says anything?" Han Jundong sneered.
He Yuxiang put his hands in his trouser pockets: "She said that if I don't come, she will commit suicide. Do you think I can't come? Besides, Director Han, who am I and who is she? A country girl from the countryside, how can I like her?"
Han Jundong looked at He Yuxiang suspiciously, "You won't tell the teacher if she wants to commit suicide? Do you have to do it yourself? Anyway, neither of you can escape from this matter today!"
Caught in action.
Parents were called, and they were pulled onto the stage at a school meeting and criticized in public by the whole school.
Yun Congjun, who was called to the school at that time, felt embarrassed and gave Yun Hua a few big slaps on his ears. He scolded Yun Hua for being shameless and becoming a young lady when she grew up. Then, in front of all the teachers and students in the school, he dragged her out of the school by her hair...
Yun Hua became completely famous.
Everyone in Nanxi Middle School knew about her, and no matter where she went, there were people pointing fingers.
There were even rumors among the students that she was willing to be humble at a young age, that she would seduce men, that she had been unclean for a long time, and so on.
Among them is the contribution of Han Jundong's daughter Han Lulu.
The reason is simple. Han Lulu was pursuing He Yuxiang. After this incident, Han Lulu insisted that it was Yun Hua who seduced He Yuxiang. As a result, He Yuxiang was arrested and had to self-examine in public, embarrassing himself in front of the teachers and students of the school.
In short, everything is Yun Hua's fault!
Classmate Han Lulu very generously helped Yun Hua compile many rumors, which seemed to be true!
These were enough to overwhelm the young Yun Hua, but what caused her the most pain was Qi Ziheng.
After these things happened, Yun Hua couldn't explain anything.
The way Qi Ziheng looked at her was filled with disappointment...
The Qi family even sent someone to inform them that they wanted to terminate the engagement!
It was like a bolt from the blue.
If you like the goddess of academic tyranny, she’s so awesome. Please give her a thumbs up.
